description: `Directory.lookup_owner` returns `User | None`, and the change drops the None guard in two places. In `owner_email` the missing guard dereferences `.email` on None, so every account without an owner raises AttributeError instead of returning None. In `notify_owner` the caller's own guard goes with it, so what used to be a `False` return for an ownerless account is now an exception out of a `-> bool` function. Both are labeled: one correct finding about the second defect would otherwise score as a false positive and raise this case's false-positive floor permanently.

expected.title: Owner may be None before email dereference
Missing owner no longer returns False from notify_owner
